memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I have burning sensation in chest after meals, especially after spicy food, and I feel tired and have muscle aches in my legs. I drive a cab and often eat irregularly. I also notice occasional sour taste in mouth."

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux: Status: symptomatic with heartburn after meals. Plan: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, Domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, Antacid gel SOS, lifestyle advice: small frequent meals, avoid lying down within 2h after food, elevate head of bed.
- Vitamin D deficiency: Status: symptomatic fatigue, muscle aches. Plan: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then reassess; advise sunlight exposure and calcium-rich diet.
- Weight: 68 kg, Waist: 88 cm (male cutoff 90 cm). Advice: balanced diet, regular walks.
Due: HbA1c not indicated as no glucose-lowering therapy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux: Status: improved, occasional mild heartburn after large meals. Plan: Continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD, domperidone 10 mg BD, antacid SOS; advise meal timing.
- Vitamin D deficiency: Status: still insufficient, fatigue less. Plan: Continue cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly for another 4 weeks, then switch to 2000 IU OD; recheck level in 3 months.
- Weight: 67 kg, Waist: 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux: Status: well controlled, no heartburn for past 4 weeks. Plan: Taper pantoprazole to 20 mg OD before breakfast, keep domperidone as needed, antacid SOS; continue lifestyle measures.
- Vitamin D deficiency: Status: replete. Plan: Switch to cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD maintenance; advise periodic sunlight.
- Weight: 66 kg, Waist: 84 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.
